accepted_claims: Every MC-003 admitted motion class (stationary, line, circular arc, helical arc, polyline, spline, piecewise motion and timed-phase motion) now has an explicit source-faithful evaluator/enclosure rule and either a checked finite bound or an inherited named proof obligation.

Rigid setup transforms, reclamps and machine transitions preserve the exact right-handed column-vector source semantics, immutable historical intent, explicit units/order and monotone inherited error rather than silently reinterpreting saved operations.

For a finite cutter with certified support radius rho and the same exact engaged parameter set, a pose enclosure transfers to the actual cutter sweep by e_total = e_inherited + e_translation + rho*e_rotation + e_tool; centreline error alone is explicitly insufficient when cutter extent or orientation error is nonzero.

Circular-arc subdivision uses the exact turn fraction and a conservative rational pi upper bound only as an enclosure, never as equality or predicate authority; semantic endpoints are restored exactly and no algebraic-trigonometric assumption is introduced.
Non-rational B-splines retain exact Cox-de Boor/knot semantics and may be bounded by exact knot insertion, control-hull enclosures or exact rational derivative bounds without a knot epsilon.
Exact, signed-neighbour, subdivision, covariance, endpoint, engagement, cutter-length, unit/order and error-composition adversarial controls are deterministic and candidate-independent.
open_claims: PB-007-01 remains open: MC-058 does not provide an unconditional finite exact decision for tangential, multiple or singular transcendental equality events.
PB-007-02 remains open: MC-058 does not provide the unconditional general constructive membership route for coupled helical/spindle-feed/eccentric sweeps.
PO-02 remains OPEN because downstream MC-018 through MC-023 still own actual cutter-sweep construction/qualification over their process slices.
PO-05 remains OPEN because an enclosure/refinement contract is not a universal termination proof for the inherited exact-event blockers.
PO-06 remains OPEN because this task supplies one error-transfer interface, not the complete source-to-reconstruction certificate chain.
MC-B, MC-C, MC-D, MC-E, MC-F and MC-1 remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
adversarial_controls: reject saved-source mutation, endpoint deletion or engagement-boundary trimming
reject decimal/algebraic-pi authority or assumed algebraic trigonometric constants
reject circular-arc epsilon fitting and polyline cross-vertex shortcuts
reject spline knot snapping or epsilon multiplicity semantics
reject independent-angle substitution for shared timed path/phase motion
reject transform unit erasure, handedness/order changes and unnormalized q15 source semantics
reject centreline-only sweep certification when finite cutter extent or orientation error contributes
reject cutter support radius that ignores finite axial length
reject inherited/tool error channels being dropped from the composed bound
reject closure of inherited PB-007 blockers or premature MC-B promotion

review.disposition: completed bounded curve/transform and finite-cutter sweep-enclosure research contract; downstream sweep constructors may consume it while inherited exact-event blockers remain open
review.downstream_release: MC-018 through MC-023 and MC-038 may consume the MC-058 contract as an artifact; no native sweep capability or proof obligation is accepted by this task alone

blockers.summary: Unconditional finite exact decision for required tangential/multiple/singular transcendental events remains unestablished; directed sweep enclosures may remain UNCERTIFIED at equality rather than guessing.

The unconditional full constructive route for general coupled helical/spindle-feed/eccentric sweep membership remains unestablished; time/path/phase correlation cannot be factored into independent coverage.

downstream_invalidations: Any semantic change to MC-003 curve/transform/source encoding invalidates the matching MC-058 evaluator and enclosure claims and requires a prospective contract revision.
Any later cutter-origin/support convention change requires recomputing rho-based sweep transfer rather than retaining the old bound by name.

Any downstream approximation that crosses source-semantic endpoints/engagement/setup/tool/target boundaries, resets inherited error or substitutes centreline error for actual cutter extent invalidates the affected sweep certificate.
Future discharge of PB-007-01 or PB-007-02 supplements this task; it does not rewrite this task's recorded open-obligation state or fabricate native evidence.
